title: TCG:SAS-169

power.text:
Fenris doesn't exhaust.
On the defending player's turn, roll a 6-sided die. 

1-2:Move Fenris 1 zone forward. 

3-4: Move Fenris 1 zone back. 

5: Move Fenris forward until he enters a zone with a hero. 

6: Move Fenris back until he enters a zone with a hero. 

Whenever Fenris enters a zone with a hero, he starts a combat. 

Whenever Fenris would be KO'd stun him instead.
